description: This PHP script handles updating relations between entities in the vtiger CRM system, allowing the association of multiple records between modules based on user requests and redirecting afterward.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class in vtiger CRM that represents a CRM entity and provides methods such as getInstance for retrieving entity objects.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security vulnerabilities like SQL injection.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab context for the current request.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the CRMEntity for a specified module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Creates relationships between CRM entities based on provided IDs and module information.
